name: Threat From the Sea
summary: Katar sends you back to Tok'Kar before you rest. He believes Tok'Kar finished a few weapons while you were away, and one will be offered to you for your help.

sections.title: Back to Tok'Kar
sections.body: Before you rest, Katar sends you back to Tok'Kar. He believes Tok'Kar finished a few weapons while you were away. Tok'Kar will offer you one for your help. Katar says you could test its strength against the murlocs when ready, which would please him further.

sections.title: Tok'Kar's Thanks
sections.body: Tok'Kar is glad to see you return. More weapons have been made for the war on the murlocs. In thanks for bringing fresh sawtooth meat and putting a small smile on Katar's face, he gives you one.

faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Tok'Kar?
aliases: where do I get threat from the sea
faq.answer: Katar sends you to speak with Tok'Kar once more before you rest in the Swamp of Sorrows.

faq.q: Why is Tok'Kar offering a weapon?
aliases: why does tok'kar give a weapon
faq.answer: Katar believes Tok'Kar finished a few weapons while you were away, and will offer you one in thanks for your help.

faq.q: What comes next after speaking with Tok'Kar?
aliases: what follows threat from the sea
